artifact_types.name: Policy Doc
artifact_types.description: One row per Rho-Bank knowledge-base document. Catalog of what the file is about so an agent can find the right source without reading it.

columns.name: title
columns.description: Document title as written in the first heading, verbatim.

columns.name: category
columns.description: Product family, exactly one of: checking, savings, credit_card, business_checking, business_savings, business_credit, bnpl, everyone_pay, bank_accounts, referral, dispute, fraud, other.

columns.name: product
columns.description: Canonical product name if the doc is about one product (e.g. 'Green Account', 'Sky Blue', 'Silver Rewards Card', 'Green Fee-Free Account'). Empty if the doc is general policy spanning many products.

columns.name: topic
columns.description: What the doc is for, 2-6 words from: eligibility, rates_and_fees, apy_boost, opening, closing, rewards, travel, atm, wire, fraud, lost_stolen, pin_lock, dispute, provisional_credit, referral, limits, interest_credit, or similar.

columns.name: key_facts
columns.description: 2-6 sentences of every number and hard rule: APY/APR, fees, min/max, windows, tier caps, eligibility, tool names. Quote figures exactly. Empty only if the doc has none.

artifact_types.name: Rate
artifact_types.description: One row per numeric fact (APY, fee, limit, window). A product overview has MANY rows — emit one per table cell and stated amount. Never collapse a doc to one row. Skip prose-only docs.

columns.name: product
columns.description: Canonical product this number applies to (e.g. 'Green Account', 'Evergreen Account', 'Sky Blue', 'Green Fee-Free Account'). Use 'all_checking' / 'all_savings' / 'all_cards' / 'all' when the rule is bank-wide.

columns.name: metric
columns.description: Canonical metric: apy, apy_boost, apr, annual_fee, monthly_fee, min_balance, atm_foreign_fee, atm_reimbursement, dispute_limit, referral_bonus, referral_window_days, referral_cap, company_age_max_years, tenure_days, other.

columns.name: value_num
columns.description: The number only, no units. Percents as the percent itself (4.5 not 0.045). Dollars as the dollar amount (15 not 1500 cents). Days/counts as integers. Null only if the value is non-numeric.

columns.name: value_text
columns.description: The value as written (e.g. '4.5%', '$15.00', '2 per 9 days', 'Entry Tier max 2').

columns.name: unit
columns.description: One of: percent, usd, count, days, years. Empty if not applicable.

columns.name: condition
columns.description: When this number applies: tier, linked-account pairing, promo window, balance band, card present vs not, Rho-Bank ATM vs third-party, Entry/Mid/Premium/Elite. Empty if unconditional.

artifact_types.name: Procedure
artifact_types.description: One row per agent protocol (dispute, PIN lock, lost/stolen, referral, interest-credit). Multiple rows when the doc lists several rules. Skip marketing docs with no procedure.

columns.name: name
columns.description: Short procedure name: debit_dispute, atm_dispute, pin_lock, lost_stolen, freeze_card, replace_card, provisional_credit, referral, interest_credit, interest_discrepancy, account_open, account_close, transfer_human, or similar.

columns.name: applies_to
columns.description: Product, card tier, or family this rule applies to (e.g. 'Entry Tier debit', 'Green Account', 'all debit cards', 'Sky Blue').

columns.name: trigger
columns.description: When to use this rule, 5-15 words (e.g. 'unauthorized debit after lost wallet', 'PIN locked after 3 failed attempts', 'customer wants to submit a checking referral').

columns.name: key_rule
columns.description: The hard constraint or required sequence, 1-3 sentences, with every number and required argument value quoted exactly (dispute_category enum values, delivery method, reason codes, rolling 9-day / 2-bonus cap, company age limit).

columns.name: tool_hint
columns.description: Discoverable or built-in tool name the doc names (e.g. file_debit_card_transaction_dispute_6281, reset_debit_card_pin_6284, submit_referral, apply_savings_account_credit_6831). Empty if none.
